title.zh: 大型赛事直播业务保障

description.zh: 城市马拉松赛事直播保障闭环：业务保障智能体生成策略，无线域智能体执行功率提升时发现节能 SLA 冲突并经 A2A-T 协商裁定；KQI 劣化后关闭全部节能并跨站协同优化，恢复后回归初始配置。
description.en: City-marathon live broadcast assurance closed loop: the Assurance Agent generates the policy, the RAN Agent discovers an energy-saving SLA conflict during power boost and resolves it via A2A-T negotiation; KQI degradation triggers a full energy-saving shutdown with inter-site coordination, and the initial configuration is restored after recovery.

name.zh: 赛事信息解析与保障订阅
功率提升与节能 SLA 冲突协商
关闭全部节能并跨站协同优化
保障结果汇总与恢复策略下发

text.zh: 收到客户需求 REQ-2026-1102，正在解析客户意图并匹配保障方案。
text.en: Customer request REQ-2026-1102 received; parsing intent and matching an assurance plan.

text.zh: 客户要求对马拉松赛事进行体验保障，保证需求 REQ-2026-1102：赛事期间直播连续流畅、公专网协同联动。
text.en: Customer requests experience assurance for the marathon event (REQ-2026-1102): continuous smooth live streaming and coordinated public-private network operation.

text.zh: 意图解析完成：匹配「大型活动体验保障」方案，需要组建跨域保障团队协同执行。
text.en: Intent parsed: matched the Large-Event Experience Assurance plan; assembling a cross-domain agent team.

text.zh: 团队组建 1/3：接入 直播域智能体，负责赛事直播质量监控与体验保障。
text.en: Team assembly 1/3: Live Streaming Agent joined for live QoE monitoring.

text.zh: 团队组建 2/3：接入 业务保障智能体，负责保障策略生成与跨域协同裁定。
text.en: Team assembly 2/3: Assurance Agent joined for strategy generation and cross-domain arbitration.

text.zh: 团队组建 3/3：接入 无线域智能体，负责无线资源配置与节能协同。
text.en: Team assembly 3/3: RAN Agent joined for radio resource configuration and energy coordination.

text.zh: 保障团队组建完成（3/3）。任务移交：按 REQ-2026-1102 执行马拉松赛事全程体验保障，直播域牵头。
text.en: Team ready (3/3). Handing over: run full-event experience assurance per REQ-2026-1102, led by the Live Streaming Agent.

text.zh: 工作流编排完成：9 个执行步骤、3 个智能体协同。请确认编排，确认后启动执行。
text.en: Workflow orchestration ready: 9 execution steps across 3 agents. Please confirm to start execution.

agents.zh: 3 个智能体协同：直播域 / 业务保障 / 无线域
agents.en: 3 agents in coordination: Live-streaming / Assurance / RAN

name.zh: 赛事信息解析与保障订阅
功率提升与节能 SLA 冲突协商
关闭全部节能并跨站协同优化
name.en: Deactivate all energy-saving and cross-site optimization

name.zh: 保障结果汇总与恢复策略下发

text.zh: 收到大型马拉松赛事直播保障订阅：主会场 + 赛道沿线 4 个小区，直播时长约 3 小时，要求卡顿率 < 1%。
text.en: Received the marathon live broadcast assurance subscription: venue + 4 cells along the course, ~3 hours on air, stall rate must stay below 1%.

text.zh: 本地解析完成：产出保障任务清单，并注册赛道小区 KQI 监控订阅。
text.en: Local parsing done: assurance task list produced, KQI monitoring subscriptions registered for the course cells.

text.zh: 主会场 — 上行保障订阅
text.en: Venue — uplink assurance subscription

text.zh: Cell-1 ~ Cell-4 — KQI 巡检订阅
text.en: Cell-1 ~ Cell-4 — KQI patrol subscription

text.zh: 直播流 SLA: 卡顿率 < 1%
text.en: Stream SLA: stall rate < 1%

text.zh: 接收保障任务，开始生成保障策略：资源核查、带宽保障与功率提升预案。
text.en: Assurance task accepted, generating the policy: resource inventory, bandwidth assurance and a power boost plan.

text.zh: 下发功率提升任务：主会场及沿线小区射频功率提升 +3dB，保障上行直播带宽。
text.en: Dispatching the power boost task: +3dB radio power on the venue and course cells to secure uplink bandwidth.

title.zh: 射频功率提升配置下发

label.zh: 主会场及沿线小区射频功率
label.en: Cell RF power (main venue + track cells)

why.zh: 直播上行卡顿率升至 2.1%，超过保障目标 1%；根因是主会场上行带宽不足。
why.en: Uplink live-stream stall rate rose to 2.1%, above the 1% target; the root cause is insufficient uplink bandwidth at the main venue.

action.zh: 向无线域下发任务：将主会场及沿线小区射频功率提升 +3dB。
action.en: Dispatch a task to the RAN domain: boost cell RF power (main venue + track cells) by +3 dB.

impact.zh: 覆盖电平与上行速率改善；相邻小区干扰略增，需观察周边小区 KPI，必要时联动回退。
impact.en: Better coverage and uplink throughput; slightly higher adjacent-cell interference — monitor neighbor KPIs and roll back if needed.

text.zh: 发现冲突：功率提升与在网节能 SLA 冲突（Cell-3 处于深度节能）。发起 A2A-T 协商请求。
text.en: Conflict discovered: the power boost clashes with the in-service energy-saving SLA (Cell-3 is in deep sleep). Raising an A2A-T negotiation request.

text.zh: A2A-T 协商请求：申请裁定节能任务让功率部分，以完成赛事保障。
text.en: A2A-T negotiation request: asking the Assurance Agent to arbitrate energy-saving vs power headroom.

v.zh: 关闭 50% 节能任务，释放功率余量
v.en: Close 50% of energy-saving tasks to release power headroom

text.zh: 协商裁定：本次赛事保障优先 —— 关闭 Cell-3 节能任务（约 50% 节能站点），其余站点节能保留。
text.en: Negotiation resolved: the event takes priority — Cell-3 exits energy saving (~50% of sleeping sites); the rest keep sleeping.

text.zh: A2A-T 协商裁定：接受提案，授权关闭 50% 节能任务。
text.en: A2A-T negotiation result: proposal accepted, closing 50% of the energy-saving tasks is authorized.

v.zh: 赛事保障优先，接受让功率提案
v.en: Event assurance first — power-headroom proposal accepted

v.zh: 关闭约 50% 节能站点（含 Cell-3）
节能率不得低于 15%，赛事结束后复核
v.en: Energy saving must stay above 15%; re-audit after the event

title.zh: 关闭 Cell-3 节能任务（50% 站点）
title.en: Deactivate Cell-3 energy-saving task (50% of sites)

why.zh: 功率提升后仍有个别卡顿，容量不足；A2A-T 协商裁定采用节能任务关闭提案补充容量。
why.en: Stalls persist after the power boost due to limited capacity; the A2A-T negotiation adopted the energy-task-off proposal to add capacity.

action.zh: 关闭 Cell-3 区域 50% 站点的节能任务（深度节能 → 运行态）。
action.en: Deactivate energy-saving tasks on 50% of Cell-3 sites (deep energy-saving → running).

impact.zh: 小区容量与用户体验提升；站点能耗上升（预估 +5%），保障结束后需恢复。
impact.en: Higher cell capacity and user experience; site energy consumption rises (est. +5%) and must be restored after the event.

text.zh: 协商结果已执行：Cell-3 退出节能，功率提升生效，赛道覆盖电平提升。
text.en: Negotiation executed: Cell-3 woke up, power boost is live, course coverage level improved.

text.zh: KQI 监控中：卡顿率 0.6%，满足 SLA 要求，持续巡检赛道小区。
text.en: KQI nominal: stall rate 0.6%, within SLA. Continuing patrols over the course cells.

text.zh: KQI 告警：Cell-3 覆盖段卡顿率升至 4.2%，观众反馈直播卡顿，立即上报。
text.en: KQI alert: stall rate on the Cell-3 segment spiked to 4.2%, viewers report buffering. Reporting upstream.

text.zh: 收到劣化上报，启动劣化分析：初判为 Cell-3 负载激增与节能策略残留冲突叠加。
text.en: Degradation report received, analysis started: preliminary — a Cell-3 load surge amplified by residual energy-saving conflicts.

text.zh: 保障决策：关闭全部节能站点，启动跨站协同优化，优先恢复直播体验。
text.en: Decision: shut down ALL energy-saving sites and start inter-site coordinated optimization — viewer experience first.

title.zh: 关闭全部节能站点并启动跨站协同优化
title.en: Deactivate ALL energy-saving sites and start cross-site coordination

why.zh: 赛事人流峰值到来，直播体验再次劣化（卡顿率 1.8%），50% 关闭仍不足。
why.en: Crowd peak degrades the live experience again (stall rate 1.8%); deactivating 50% is no longer enough.

action.zh: 关闭全部节能站点，并启动邻区载波均衡与迁移参数协同调整。
action.en: Deactivate ALL energy-saving sites and start neighbor-carrier balancing with coordinated mobility parameters.

impact.zh: 全网容量最大化、直播体验恢复；能耗进一步上升，参数调整范围扩大至全区域，恢复需分批执行避免网络冲击。
impact.en: Maximizes network capacity and restores the live experience; energy use rises further and the parameter scope spans the whole area — restore in batches to avoid network shocks.

text.zh: 执行中：关闭全部节能任务，邻区载波均衡与迁移参数协同调整。
text.en: Executing: all energy-saving tasks shutting down; neighbor carrier balancing and mobility parameters being tuned together.

text.zh: 全部节能任务已关闭，跨站协同优化完成，Cell-3 负载已回落至安全水位。
text.en: All energy-saving tasks are off, inter-site coordination finished, Cell-3 load is back to a safe level.

caption.zh: 跨站协同覆盖恢复示意（Cell-1/3/4）

text.zh: KQI 复核通过：卡顿率回落至 0.7%，KQI 恢复达标，直播恢复流畅。
text.en: Re-check passed: stall rate back to 0.7%, KQI within SLA, the stream is smooth again.

text.zh: 汇总保障结果：故障历时 38 秒，全程 SLA 最终达成，输出保障报告并下发恢复策略。
text.en: Summary: the incident lasted 38s, SLA ultimately met. Assurance report produced and the recovery policy dispatched.

text.zh: 恢复策略已下发至无线域：按预案分批恢复节能配置，避免二次冲击。
text.en: Recovery policy dispatched to the RAN domain: staged energy-saving restoration to avoid a second disturbance.

title.zh: 节能配置分批恢复下发

why.zh: 保障目标已达成（KQI 达标、卡顿率 < 1%），保障结束，需将网络恢复至保障前基线。
why.en: The assurance target is met (KQI on target, stall rate < 1%) and the event has ended — restore the network to its pre-assurance baseline.

action.zh: 按预案分批恢复节能策略与功率配置至保障前基线。
action.en: Batch-restore the energy-saving policy and power configuration to the pre-assurance baseline.

impact.zh: 恢复节能、降低能耗；分批执行避免二次网络冲击，期间用户体验波动可控。
impact.en: Energy-saving resumes and consumption drops; batched execution avoids a second network shock with controlled user-experience fluctuation.

text.zh: 初始配置恢复完成：节能策略、功率参数均已回归保障前基线。
text.en: Initial configuration restored: energy-saving policies and power parameters are back to the pre-event baseline.

text.zh: 保障闭环完成：直播全程 SLA 达成，保障工单归档。
text.en: Closed loop complete: SLA met for the whole broadcast, the assurance ticket is archived.

text.zh: 本次保障服务已全流程闭环，服务总结如下。
text.en: The assurance service is fully closed-loop. Summary below.

value.zh: REQ-2026-1102 大型活动体验保障需求已全流程闭环
value.en: The large-event assurance request is fully closed-loop

value.zh: CRM组建 直播域/业务保障/无线域 3 智能体协同保障
value.en: CRM assembled a 3-agent team (live-streaming / assurance / RAN)

value.zh: 4 项配置变更全部经您授权后执行：功率提升、A2A-T 裁定关节能、关闭全部节能站点、分批恢复
value.en: All 4 config changes executed under your authorization (power boost, A2A-T decision, energy sites off, batched restore)

value.zh: KQI 全程达标，直播卡顿率 < 1%，业务零中断，节能策略已恢复基线
value.en: KQI on target throughout, stall rate < 1%, zero service interruption, energy policy restored
